In a vlog-style intro, a smiling blonde woman and a man wearing a black cap are seated next to each other on a couch with yellow and orange cushions. Both individuals are dressed in black T-shirts. The man raises his index finger as he speaks to the camera. "hikaloholics_dna" is printed in the upper left corner of the frame. As the video transitions, scenic mountain views are featured. Later, Alette and Deen introduce themselves, explaining that their video features hiking videos and gear reviews. The video transitions to a screen that reads: "7 MISTAKES PEOPLE MAKE WHILE HIKING AND PLANNING THE TOUR DU MONT BLANC HOW TO AVOID THEM." Then, the video transitions back to Alette and Deen sitting on the couch, followed by footage of people hiking through a village surrounded by mountains. A woman and a man are shown hiking along a narrow trail. Later in the clip, Alette and Deen appear on the couch again, stating that they will be telling people about seven mistakes that people make while hiking and planning the Tour du Mont Blanc and how to avoid them. Finally, the scene transitions to text superimposed over a mountain backdrop, reading "MISTAKE #1" in large white letters.

The video begins with a view of hikers walking on a narrow path in a grassy area with snowy mountains visible in the background. Text overlaid reads "Mistake #1: Not planning ahead" (Fout #1: Niet vooruitplannen). The scene transitions to a couple, a woman with long brown hair and a black shirt and a man with a black shirt and baseball cap, sitting on a couch in front of a light green wall, looking into the camera as they discuss their topic. Next, the video cuts to a group of hikers trekking up a rocky path, obscured by fog. A fourth scene shows a group of hikers walking away from the camera on a dirt road surrounded by lush green trees. In this scene text overlaid reads "Plan months ahead" (Plan maanden van tevoren). The scene switches again to a Facebook page labeled "Tour Du Mont Blanc", depicting a lone hiker against a backdrop of snowy mountain peaks. Finally, the video returns to the couple, who continue their explanation, with the man adding that the huts are usually fully booked. The text on the screen then reads "Fully Booked" (Volgeboekt).

The video segment features two people sitting on a couch against a green backdrop. On the left, a woman with long blonde hair and a black T-shirt gestures with her hands as she speaks. To her right sits a man with a beard and a black cap and T-shirt. He looks at the camera with a neutral expression, occasionally glancing at the woman. Between them are two pillows, one orange and one yellow. Above them, in the upper left corner, is the text “@hikaholics_dna”. The woman points towards a graphic that appears between them, displaying the website address “www.montourdumontblanc.com”. The graphic shows a part of the website, featuring the Tour du Mont Blanc hiking trail. Both point down towards the website address.

As the man speaks, a Patreon support icon and banner pop up in the center of the screen with the text “Support me on Patreon” and “www.patreon.com/hikaholics Join” respectively. The woman expresses her gratitude for viewers’ support, which helps them create videos. In closing remarks, they ask viewers to drop a mountain emoji if they watched until the end. The scene ends with them waving bye and the words "Subscribe to our channel" appearing in a text overlay below an arrow pointing upward.
